name: Main Block
detail: Classrooms for 6 to 10, staff room and the Principal’s office.

name: Science Laboratory
detail: Physics, Chemistry and Biology lab with 40 work stations.

name: Computer Lab
detail: 30 systems with broadband, used from Class 6 upward.

name: Library
detail: Over 6,000 Tamil and English titles, with a quiet reading area.

name: School Office
detail: Admissions, fee counter and certificate requests.

name: Assembly Ground
detail: Morning assembly, Annual Day and the sports meet.

name: Canteen
detail: Mid-day meal counter and a snacks stall.

name: Bus Bay
detail: Four school buses; children board here under staff supervision.
